headline: Portugal's 2025 IRS in Lean matches the OECD to the cent once its band-sum convention is used; the statute's own rounded average rates make the tax non-monotone and the quociente conjugal occasionally dearer, the August-September 2025 withholding cut returned ~13× the January-July excess (under-withholding almost everyone), and the abono de família and joint mínimo de existência create 250-1 914 € notches.
